summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase 9s: Vocotap + Hoop (Treesh Active) on own profile Stats tab, MySpace-style full-page profile layout, 3 coming-soon arcade games (Bronze Blitz / Ebonics / Sonoku), /support.html standalone Help Center with FormSubmit mocking, in-app Help center via Settings→Help, Admin-only MAD tool in Settings→Account, public profile Arcade tab + privacy sheet row + sxPublish gating, and regression smoke. ~100% pass across 9 feature groups. All data-testid hooks from the review request were verified. Verified exact values: Vocotap chip 'Level 3', Best score 120.3k, Max combo 233×, Plays 2, Accuracy 96.4%, Top stars 4★, Day streak 3; Hoop sessions 12, minutes 340, drills 8, games 7, shots 44, best 88, 28 heat squares with 3 on, '3 active days', recent HORSE(Winner: Tester)+Around the World, '2 saved courts', hoop-streak '3 day streak'. Empty states: arcade-games-empty + treesh-active-empty + treesh-active-open-hoop present with no keys. Full-page profile at 1920: #profile-panel has sp-page, profile-banner spans full width (1920px) at top:0, sp-info in left column, avatar visible/not clipped. Styled space (glitter/accent/about/meet/mood) renders profile-space-bg, profile-section-about-me, profile-section-who-like-to-meet, profile-status-badge. Style editor drawer opens, editor-theme-neon live-switches, editor-save closes drawer + persists space.theme='neon'. Arcade tiles: all 3 soon tiles (game-open-bronze-blitz/ebonics/sonoku) with 'Soon' badges + 'Coming soon' labels; existing FREA!/Vocotap/Chainz/Nects tiles still present. Sonoku info modal: game-info-soon-sonoku DISABLED, no play button, 'Not live yet' pill + 'treesh.app/games/sonoku' pill. openGameFrame('sonoku') from console does NOT open frame, shows toast 'Sonoku is coming soon'. Settings→System&About: about-help-center-open, about-support-open, about-feedback-open all present; clicking Help center opens game-frame loaded with support.html. /support.html: all 11 areas (support-area-start, library, now-playing, lyrics, studios, games, profiles, accounts, settings, privacy, faq) + FAQ has 10 <details>. Search 'delete' yields '1 result' meta + hides non-matching, nonsense query shows support-search-empty, clearing restores all areas. Form validation: invalid email → 'Check your email'; <10 char msg → 'Tell us a little more'. FormSubmit intercepted: success→'Message sent' + reset; false→'We couldn’t send that'; abort→'You might be offline' + mailto:support@treesh.app. Posted JSON includes email/topic/message/_subject 'Treesh support: Account & sign in'/device/screen/page when support-form-device checkbox checked. ?topic=bug preselects 'Bug report'. Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow. Public profile Arcade tab (as non-admin alice viewing bella in sb_mock): bella privacy {arcade:'friends'} and alice not friend → uprof-tab-arcade visible, uprof-locked-arcade present, uprof-arcade body hidden; privacy {arcade:'me'} → no arcade tab; empty privacy → full uprof-arcade with arcade-game-vocotap+chip 'Level 3' + uprof-stats-treesh-active with uprof-hoop-stat-sessions '5Sessions' + uprof-hoop-streak '2 day streak' + recent games WITHOUT 'Winner:'. Own privacy sheet: hero-privacy button opens privacy-sheet with privacy-row-arcade label 'Arcade & Treesh Active' + privacy-arcade-everyone/friends/me buttons that save to treesh_social.sections.arcade. sxPublish(true) with arcade='everyone' writes public_data.arcade with games+hoop and recent items lacking 'w'; with arcade='me' omits public_data.arcade. Admin MAD tool: with mod.ua1.role='admin', Settings→Account shows mod-settings-card + mod-open-dashboard + mod-mad-tool (href=https://treesh.app/tools/mad, target=_blank); role='moderator' shows card but NO mad; no role→no card. Regression: app boots with no console errors, Library/Game/Settings navigate fine. 2 Tailwind CDN warnings only (benign).

verified_pass.own_stats_arcade_vocotap: stats-arcade-games + arcade-game-vocotap + chip 'Level 3' + rows (Best score 120.3k, Max combo 233×, Plays 2, Accuracy 96.4%, Top stars 4★, Day streak 3).
verified_pass.own_stats_treesh_active_hoop: stats-treesh-active + hoop-streak '3 day streak' + treesh-active-hoop + stat tiles sessions/minutes/drills/games/shots/best + hoop-activity-strip 28 squares/3 on + recent HORSE (Winner: Tester) + Around the World + hoop-courts '2 saved courts' + treesh-active-hoop-open opens Hoop info modal.
verified_pass.empty_states: No hoop/vocotap keys → arcade-games-empty + treesh-active-empty + treesh-active-open-hoop present.
verified_pass.fullpage_profile_desktop: sp-page on #profile-panel, profile-banner full width (1920px) at top:0, sp-info left column, avatar fully visible/not clipped. Styled space renders profile-space-bg + about-me + who-like-to-meet + status-badge.
verified_pass.myspace_editor: profile-edit-style-button opens myspace-editor-drawer; editor-theme-neon updates live; editor-save-profile-style-button saves (space.theme='neon' persisted) + closes.
verified_pass.arcade_coming_soon: games-arcade shows all 3 soon tiles (bronze-blitz/ebonics/sonoku) with Soon ribbons + 'Coming soon' labels + existing frea/vocotap/chainz/nects intact. Info modal shows game-info-soon-<key> DISABLED + no play btn + 'Not live yet' + treesh.app/games/<key> pill. openGameFrame('sonoku') blocked + toast 'Sonoku is coming soon'.
verified_pass.settings_help: about-help-center-open opens game-frame with support.html; about-support-open + about-feedback-open rows intact.
verified_pass.support_html: All 10 areas + FAQ with 10 details, search 'delete' filters topics with '1 result' meta + support-search-empty on nonsense + restored on clear, form validation (email/short msg), FormSubmit success/error/offline paths via page.route, request JSON contains email/topic/message/_subject/device/screen/page, ?topic=bug preselects 'Bug report', mobile 390 no horizontal overflow.
verified_pass.public_profile_arcade: Non-admin viewer: friends privacy → uprof-tab-arcade + uprof-locked-arcade; me privacy → no tab; everyone → full uprof-arcade with vocotap chip 'Level 3' + uprof-stats-treesh-active + hoop-sessions 5 + streak '2 day streak' + recent games WITHOUT 'Winner:'.
verified_pass.own_privacy_sheet: hero-privacy opens privacy-sheet with privacy-row-arcade 'Arcade & Treesh Active' + buttons everyone/friends/me saving to treesh_social.sections.arcade.
verified_pass.sx_publish_gating: sxPublish(true) with arcade='everyone' writes public_data.arcade (games+hoop with recent items lacking 'w'); with arcade='me' omits public_data.arcade.
verified_pass.mad_tool: role=admin: mod-settings-card + mod-open-dashboard + mod-mad-tool (href=https://treesh.app/tools/mad, target=_blank). role=moderator: card yes, mad no. no role: no card.

notes.admin_bypasses_privacy: First privacy test with alice=admin saw full arcade data despite friends/me privacy on bella. This is expected: sb_mock's get_user_profile grants staff full visibility (line 39: 'st||r===self||v===everyone...'). Verified correctly with alice as regular user.
notes.sb_account_card_cache: stLoad(60s cache) means Settings→Account must have stLoad(true) called after role change for mod-settings-card to appear/disappear in-session. Test iteration_19 noted this; p9o.js adds stLoad(true) to settings-paint which handles it on tab re-paint.

critical_code_review_comments: p9s.js is ~68 lines doing a lot — clean, single-file push into GAME_DATA_SOURCES/SX_SECS/GAMES is appropriate for this phase. Consider extracting HOOP_GAMES constant to a shared module if more phases depend on it.
p9s.js gdArcadeHtml: sanitizes strings via .slice(X) and esc() consistently — good XSS hygiene on untrusted public_data.
p9s.js openGameFrame override: nice defensive gating on g.soon with user-facing toast; aria-disabled added to the CTA button.
p9s.js sxSnapshot override: correctly maps recent items to {g,at} dropping winner — matches privacy contract to not leak user names via public profiles.
support.html form: FormSubmit payload includes device+screen+page which could be seen as mild fingerprinting — behind opt-in checkbox (support-form-device) which is correct.
sb_mock.js line 39: 'arcade' included in the privacy-filtered sections list and in sxTabs/sxTabHtml locked-section flow — works end-to-end.
test_credentials: Mock harness only /_sbtest.html: a@test.com / secret123 (ua1 alice). Secondary bella ub1 seeded directly into __mock_sb_db.profiles. /app/memory/test_credentials.md intact.
seed_data_creation: Real app /: localStorage seeds for stats (treesh_hoop_stats, treesh_hoop_game_log, treesh_hoop_favorites, vocotap_scores, vocotap_progress, vocotap_daily_history) + treesh_profile with space. Mock /_sbtest.html: __mock_sb_db with alice/bella profiles including bella.public_data.arcade {games, hoop} and privacy rotations (everyone/friends/me); mod {ua1: {role: admin|moderator|<none>}}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 9s features all pass. Key gotchas: (1) Admin role bypasses privacy filters in sb_mock — use a non-admin signed-in user to validate privacy. (2) Staff/role cache (stLoad 60s) means role changes require stLoad(true) + Settings tab re-paint to see mod-settings-card appear/disappear. (3) Help center opens inside game-frame (support.html loaded via src attribute set elsewhere — the raw src attr check returned null but iframe content loaded correctly). (4) FormSubmit MUST be mocked — the ajax endpoint sends real emails. (5) Support search's support-search-empty element is always in DOM; verify by checking it is the only visible one for nonsense queries. Build: python3 /app/memory/patch_p9.py && python3 /app/memory/build_sbtest.py && node /app/memory/build_support.js.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found this iteration.
